name: D16 read-only causal-history commitment separability audit
purpose: test whether physically structured recent history resolves the exact D15 snapshot commitment aliases before training a temporal graph
scope: D3+D12 TRAIN fit and primary validation folds only; no model fitting, joint validation, DEV, or TEST

history_representation.state_features: unchanged D14 anonymous graph inputs at each state
history_representation.transition_features: three signed differences of consecutive graph node/edge/gripper features
history_representation.control_features: executed Cartesian targets relative to the source-state gripper, scaled by D13 fit-only action scales, plus gripper command
history_representation.object_symmetry: one consistent object permutation across the complete four-state history; minimize over all six permutations
history_representation.snapshot_distance: unchanged D15 equal-weight raw scene/action distance
history_representation.history_context_distance: RMS over graph transition and executed-control features
history_representation.augmented_distance: equal-weight RMS combination of snapshot and history-context distances

primary_subset: the exact D15 reference-positive, D14-predicted-nonpositive commitment groups

decision.pass_both_axes: freeze one structured temporal object-graph training experiment with unchanged D14 outputs, losses, split, and budget
decision.otherwise: do not train another history model; prospectively collect richer generic robot joint/velocity, end-effector twist, and contact force/impulse state
